description: This source file defines the CredentialsObject class, which models credentials for a device in the Eclipse Hono framework. It provides methods to create, validate, and manage various types of credentials, including password hashes, pre-shared keys, and X.509 certificates. It also encapsulates secret management and validity periods, supporting the Credentials API specification.

classes.name: CredentialsObject
classes.description: A final class representing device credentials, supporting multiple credential types and validation mechanisms, extending JsonBackedValueObject for JSON serialization and deserialization.
